rows.grounds: compound of siddheśvarī and mataṃ; accusative object of proktaṃ
past participle of pra-vac; neuter accusative singular
compound of sarva, siddhi, and pradāyaka; modifies mataṃ

items.question: Which declared opinion is said to give all accomplishments?
premises: The verse names the source of all accomplishments.
items.inference: The declared Siddheśvarī opinion is the all-accomplishment-giving teaching.
uncertainties: Exact ritual context of Siddheśvarī is not specified.
items.plain_english: The opinion of Siddheśvarī is declared, which gives all accomplishments.
